result.claim_boundary: Internal project-operated evidence from exactly two precommitted ARC tasks in one rotate-180 family, considered alongside one earlier transpose-family episode. It supports only the exact bounded rotate-180 unit and the continued use of its controls; it does not establish generalized ARC capability, compositional or cross-family transfer, production readiness, autonomous self-improvement, Candidate activation, AGI, upper-objective completion, task completion, or user-level completion.
result.next: Return to Root and select a materially different immutable ARC transfer unit outside the already tested transpose and rotate-180 families, preferably compositional or structurally different. Retain answer-excluding selection, pre-reveal freezing, deterministic scoring, family and leakage controls, exact replay suppression, zero-upstream-write auditing, protected exact-head CI, expected-head merge, remote readback, and separate bounded versus upper-objective verdicts.
result.reason: This episode adds one well-controlled rotate-180 transfer result, but the reusable immutable-source, pre-reveal, holder, leakage, replay, Candidate-gating, and separated-verdict controls already exist. Together with the earlier transpose-family result it supports continuing cross-family measurement, not creating or activating a new prompt or mechanism Candidate, and it remains far below any broad capability or AGI claim.
retained_learning: Bind each external benchmark unit to an immutable upstream commit, exact task identities, an answer-excluding deterministic selector, content digests, and a zero-upstream-write audit.
Freeze the same baseline for both tasks before learning, restrict the learning record to task-A evidence, and freeze the task-B prediction before task-B output reveal.
Retain source, selector, task-identity, transformation-family, holder-commitment, leaked-answer, and duplicate-replay controls so provenance, isolation, and exact-once behavior can be recomputed.
Report baseline task-A, baseline task-B, and adapted task-B scores separately; an exact adapted result is evidence only for the precommitted task pair and transformation family.

The transpose and rotate-180 episodes are two narrow same-family-within-unit results, not evidence of open-ended rule induction, robust cross-family composition, autonomous continual learning, production reliability, AGI, or satisfaction of the user-level objective.

Keep bounded-unit, task, user-level, upper-objective, Candidate-activation, production-routing, and AGI verdicts separate through Execute, Task Evaluate, Candidate Evaluate, Consolidate, Learn, and Root.
Protected exact-head CI, expected-head merge, and remote blob readback establish engineering durability but cannot widen the empirical capability claim.
